title: Turbo Hero Sprint
description: Dash at breakneck speed across action-packed obstacle tracks—smash crates, collect power boosts, and race past every trap to the finish.
controls: Swipe to dodge hazards, jump gaps, and grab speed boosts along the track.

zh-CN.title: 疯跑英雄
zh-CN.description: 爽快冲刺跑酷疯跑英雄：控制英雄全速狂飙、撞破障碍吃满加速能量，一路狂奔直冲终点！
zh-CN.controls: 左右滑动闪避障碍并起跳跨越沟壑，拾取道具一路狂飙冲线。
